reviews.t: Nice for scalp, AMAZING for hair!
reviews.x: I love this stuff! It’s scent is a little weird because it’s banana but there’s menthol in it. I don’t hate it, but it’s not a regular banana scent. The smell doesn’t even matter—there is nothing out there (I’ve tried olaplex, salon formulas, etc) that makes my dry, brittle, bleached hair this smooth, soft, and shiny. I first found it at Costco (in packets), was happy to find it here in a tube. I just wish this brand would start marketing more shampoos too, I’d be all in!

My hair tends to be on the dry side, so I try to look for scalp masks that helps moisturize but tend to have a lot of fragrance added. This mask has definitely helped my scalp when it needs the extra care without the harsh fragrances. It’s soothes my scalp and leaves my scalp feeling extra clean :) Definitely recommend!

claims.text: Many reviewers discovered the product through an Ipsy subscription and came back to buy more.
Reviewers frequently say it leaves hair soft, smooth, and hydrated.
Several reviewers report it soothes irritated scalps and helps control oil, flakes, or buildup.
The scent is often praised, though some find it strong or unusual (rosemary or banana/menthol).
A few reviewers complain about packaging or value, such as receiving a single packet for the price.
